title: We compiled a list of all AI Trading related companies/projects. You guys are always asking for this, so we are finally sharing. Let's colab on making this list bigger.
author: Traditional_Ear5237
selftext:
Hi everyone. My friends and I compiled this google sheet list of all the companies and projects who at least claim they have something related to AI trading. Some of them actually do, some of them are just riding a hype train. We want to make this into a project we can run continuously and not without your help. I am sharing this list with you here today. We compiled it a few months back. So it might be already outdated. Hoping that perhaps you will find some projects which you like from this list. In return I am asking you to provide in comments more projects which we perhaps missed and we will research them and add them to the list. This way we together can be growing this list and have this as a storage where anyone who is looking for something, can always find it.

Beware there are some truly impressive ones in there, and many of them are useless, if you have had experience with some of the projects from the list, please share with everyone here in the comments as well so we can make changes to our descriptions of these companies.

Enjoy and lmk if this was in any way helpful. 

[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/12bLqZgNlY5GwROKAB\_4bBJzPGGye\_tGMHE99XtAcyoU/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/12bLqZgNlY5GwROKAB_4bBJzPGGye_tGMHE99XtAcyoU/edit?usp=sharing)

comments.author: Fynca
comments.body: We’d love to have Fynca added to the list. We’re an AI-powered market research workspace, now approaching 2,000 users. Many found us through Reddit, and the experience with this community has been incredible. Happy to share more about what we built and the journey behind it.

replies.author: Traditional_Ear5237
replies.body: we will honour our word and add you guys to this list.

comments.author: bavarius13
comments.body:
I had some experience with 3commas and botico.ai. 3commas is a big trading automation geek but for me it was too complicated to understand. chatgpt suggested botico.ai when i was looking for something more simple and flexible. As a conservative trader i liked their logic building for own signal strategy. 



Thanks for sharing this list. There are many companies I never heard about it. i will check them.

replies.author: Traditional_Ear5237
replies.body: Hi, I appreciate the wholesome comment, I posted this list to several groups and got a heat for it for no damn reason. So thank you for the kindness, we will add this company to the list.

comments.author: Bergodrake
comments.body:
You should definitely add Trigol.io to the list. We’ve been building an ML-based trading platform focused on systematic 1-3 day swing trading, with signals generated from 500+ models and publicly tracked performance.

Happy to share more details if useful for the list!

replies.author: Traditional_Ear5237
replies.body: thank you, will do, you guys are added. I will share this list periodically with the communities so that everyone is up to date with what is out there.

comments.author: Legitimate-Leek4235
comments.body: Now I need an AI to independently tell me how each performs

replies.author: Traditional_Ear5237
replies.body: haha yeah, but I bet it would just hallucinate the answer, from what we checked all of the projects are relatively young except for the traditional bot platforms.
